_doc: DROID action/state normalization stats registry, keyed by data.norm_stats. Consumed by eb_jepa/data/droid_dset.py at import. All sets assume droid_to_rcasa_action_format=1; fps=5 unless the key says _fps<n>; camera_frame=false unless the key says _cf (a _cf set is measured with data.camera_frame=true and MUST be paired with it - see measure_norm_stats.py --camera-frame). dims: [dx,dy,dz,drx,dry,drz,dgrip] / [x,y,z,rx,ry,rz,grip].

full_fps5.provenance: WHOLE-DATASET exhaustive stats over 74912 episodes (73351 readable, 22505754 transitions), per-episode stride fstp=ceil(vfps/20) deltas via poses_to_diffs over all offsets; states over all frames. fstp histogram: {1: 8, 2: 9, 3: 73334}. Frame: camera_frame=false (world frame). Generated by measure_norm_stats.py.
